chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She was very nervous to go on a big airplane ride with her mommy and daddy. When they got on the airplane, Lily sat in her seat and held onto her mommy's hand very tight. She hoped that the airplane ride would be over soon.

As the airplane took off, Lily's tummy felt funny, but she tried to be brave. She looked out the window and saw the clouds and the sun. It was very pretty! Lily's mommy gave her a snack and some juice, which made her feel better. She hoped that the airplane ride would be fun after all.

After a little while, the airplane landed safely and Lily was so happy! She had a great time on her first airplane ride and she wasn't nervous anymore. She hoped that she could go on another airplane ride soon! The end.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy who loved to play with his toy cars. One day, Timmy's favorite red car got stuck under the bed. He tried to get it out, but it was too far away. Timmy's mom came to help him and used a long cord to reach the car. They were successful in getting the car out from under the bed.

Later that day, Timmy and his mom went to the park to play. Timmy was having fun until he saw a big dog that scared him. His mom saw that he was upset and asked him what was wrong. Timmy told her that he was scared of the dog. His mom told him that she would always be there to care for him and keep him safe. Timmy felt better knowing that his mom was there to protect him.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. Timmy loved to play with his toys and run around outside. One day, Timmy's mom told him that he had to clean up his toys before he could go outside. Timmy didn't want to clean up, so he asked his mom a question. "Mommy, can I please go outside now?" he said.

His mom said no, and told him that he had to follow the law of cleaning up before he could play. Timmy didn't understand what that meant, so his mom explained that it was a rule that everyone had to follow. Timmy said sorry for not knowing the rule, and started to clean up his toys.
After he finished cleaning, Timmy went outside to play. He felt happy that he followed the law and listened to his mom. From then on, he always remembered to clean up before going outside to play.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She wanted to bake cookies in the oven. She asked her mom if they could bake cookies together. Her mom said they could, but the oven was broken. Lily felt sad because she really wanted to bake cookies.

Lily's mom tried to fix the oven, but she couldn't. Lily's dad suggested they buy a new oven. They went to the store and found a comfortable oven that they all liked. But when they got home, they realized the oven was too big for their kitchen. They had a problem!

Lily's mom and dad talked about what they could do. Lily listened and had an idea. She said, "I want to bake cookies, but the oven is too big. Can we put it in the garage?" Her mom and dad thought it was a great idea. They moved the oven to the garage and Lily was finally able to bake her cookies. They were so delicious and everyone was happy!

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. One day, Lily woke up and felt a sharp pain in her tooth. She went to her mommy and said, "Mommy, my tooth hurts."
Mommy said, "Let me take a look." She saw that Lily's tooth was wiggly and ready to come out. Mommy said, "Don't worry, your tooth will fall out soon."
Later that day, Lily went to play with her friend Max. Max was being bossy and wanted to play his way. Lily said, "No Max, let's play my game." Max said, "No, we'll play my game."

Lily didn't like how Max was acting, so she rushed home to her mommy. She told her mommy what happened and mommy said, "It's okay, Lily. Max was being bossy. You can play your game with someone else."
Lily felt better and went to find someone else to play with. Her tooth was still hurting, but she knew it would fall out soon. And she was happy because she didn't have to play with a bossy friend.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a little bunny who wanted to go on an adventure. He hopped around his home, but he couldn't find anything exciting to do. Suddenly, he had an idea! He wanted to explore the underground tunnels that he had heard about.

The bunny put on his fancy hat and hopped outside. He saw a big hole in the ground and he knew that was the entrance to the underground tunnels. But he was scared to go alone, so he requested his friend, a little bird, to come with him.

Together, they hopped down the hole and into the underground tunnels. It was dark and spooky, but they had each other to keep them company. They found lots of interesting things like rocks, bugs, and even a shiny treasure! After their adventure, the bunny and the bird were tired but happy. They had so much fun exploring the underground tunnels together.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a young boy named Timmy. He loved to play outside with his friends. One day, Timmy's mom decided to grill some hot dogs for lunch. Timmy loved hot dogs and couldn't wait to eat them.

As his mom was grilling the hot dogs, Timmy's friends came over to play. They were all very excited to eat the hot dogs. But Timmy's mom warned them, "Be careful, the grill is very hot. You don't want to get burned."

Timmy and his friends were very hungry and couldn't wait to eat the hot dogs. But Timmy remembered what his mom said and prevented his friends from getting too close to the grill. "Let's wait until the hot dogs are ready and cooled down," Timmy said.

Finally, the hot dogs were ready and everyone sat down to eat. They all enjoyed the delicious hot dogs and were grateful that Timmy prevented them from getting hurt. From that day on, they always listened to Timmy's wise advice.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a little boy named Timmy. He loved to eat broccoli and always asked for it at dinner. But one day, he refused to eat it and got nervous when his mom told him he had to finish it.
Timmy's mom tried to make him eat the broccoli, but he wouldn't listen. She told him he had to surrender and eat it, but he still refused.

Days went by, and Timmy didn't eat his broccoli. He started feeling sick and went to the doctor. The doctor said he was very sick because he didn't eat his broccoli. Timmy was sad and wished he had listened to his mom.
In the end, Timmy got even sicker and had to go to the hospital. He realized that not eating his broccoli was a bad idea and wished he had surrendered to his mom's request.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She liked to play outside in the park. One day, she saw a beautiful butterfly. "Look, mommy! A pretty butterfly!" she said. "Can we bring it home?"
"No, Lily. The butterfly belongs in the world outside," her mommy replied.
Lily was sad, but then she saw a colorful flower. "Mommy, this flower is so attractive! Can we bring it home?"
"No, Lily. The flower belongs in the world outside, too. It needs sunshine and rain to grow," her mommy explained.
Lily understood and continued to play in the park, enjoying the beauty of the world around her.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a little bear named Ben. Ben loved to play in the forest, but one day he saw a big scary log. He wanted to climb it, but he was too afraid.
His friend, a little bird named Lily, saw him and came to help. She said, "Don't be scared, Ben. I will help you climb the log." But Ben refused. He didn't want to try.

Lily didn't give up. She said, "I know you can do it, Ben. You are strong and brave." Finally, Ben agreed to try. With Lily's help, he climbed the log and felt very proud of himself. From that day on, Ben learned that sometimes it's okay to be scared, but it's important to try and not refuse help from friends.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play with her toys, but her room was always messy. Her mom would say, "Lily, you need to clean up your toys and put them in their right place." But Lily would ignore her mom and continue to play.

One day, Lily's mom got very upset and said, "Lily, if you don't clean up your toys, I will have to drain all the fun out of your room." Lily didn't understand what her mom meant, but she knew it didn't sound good.

So, Lily decided to clean up her toys and put them in an organized way. Her mom was very happy and said, "Lily, you did a great job! Now you can play with your toys in a clean and organized room." Lily smiled and said, "Thank you, Mommy. I don't want you to ignore me anymore." Her mom hugged her and said, "I will never ignore you, my sweet Lily."

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a little fish named Nemo. Nemo loved to swim in the big blue ocean with his fish friends. One day, Nemo got hurt and his tail was broken. He couldn't swim anymore and he was very sad.
Nemo's friend, a kind octopus named Ollie, saw that Nemo was sad and asked him what was wrong. Nemo told Ollie that he couldn't swim anymore because his tail was broken.

Ollie said, "Don't worry, Nemo. I can help restore your tail to perfect condition!" Ollie used his magic powers to fix Nemo's tail and soon Nemo was swimming again with his friends. Nemo was so happy and he thanked Ollie for making his tail perfect again. They swam together in the ocean, laughing and playing all day long.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a farmer who had a big farm. He had many animals like cows, pigs, and chickens. The farmer worked hard every day to take care of them.
One day, a little girl came to visit the farm. She saw how the farmer used his tools to take care of the animals. She thought the tools were very useful.

The little girl admired the farmer for his hard work. She asked him if she could help. The farmer was happy to have some help and showed her how to feed the animals. The little girl was very happy to help and learned a lot about taking care of animals.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside with her yellow ball. One day, she went to the store with her mommy. Her mommy told her to pick out a toy, but Lily saw a big bag of apples. She asked her mommy, "Can I get apples instead?" Her mommy said, "Sure, but let's check the price first."

Lily looked at the price and said, "It's too much!" Her mommy said, "We can still get some, just not the whole bag." As they were walking home, Lily took a bite out of an apple. She said, "Mmm, it's yummy!"
When they got home, Lily shared her apple with her little brother. He took a bite too and said, "It's sour!" Lily laughed and said, "That's okay, I still love it."

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a hero. He was very brave and strong. He saved people from danger. One day, he went to sleep in his bed. He had a dream that made him nervous. He woke up in the middle of the night and couldn't go back to sleep.

The next day, the hero went to save people from a fire. He was nervous because it was a big fire. He went inside the building to save a little girl. But the fire was too strong. The hero couldn't save the little girl and he got hurt. He was taken to the hospital, but he didn't make it.
Everyone was sad that the hero had died. They remembered him as a brave and strong hero who saved many lives.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a boy named Timmy. Timmy liked to play with his toy cars in his garage. One day, Timmy's dad asked him to clean the garage. Timmy didn't know how to clean the garage, but he wanted to help his dad.

Timmy looked around the garage and saw that it was very messy. There were toys and tools all over the floor. He knew that he needed to make it clear so that his dad could park the car inside. Timmy started picking up the toys and tools and putting them in their right places.

After a while, Timmy's dad came to see how he was doing. He was happy to see that Timmy was helping him. Timmy was proud of himself because he knew that he did a good job. From that day on, Timmy made sure to keep the garage clear so that his dad could park the car inside.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a little mouse named Timmy. Timmy lived in a big house with lots of rooms and lots of cheese. One day, Timmy saw a match on the ground and he wanted to play with it. But his mommy told him matches are dangerous and he shouldn't touch them. Timmy thought it was stupid, but he listened to his mommy and walked away.

Later that day, Timmy was playing in the kitchen when he saw a big cat coming towards him. He knew he had to escape, so he ran as fast as he could. He ran through the living room, up the stairs and into his bedroom. The cat followed him, but Timmy was too quick and he escaped through a little hole in the wall.
Timmy was so happy he escaped from the cat, but he knew he had to be careful and listen to his mommy. He never played with matches again and he stayed safe from the big cat. The end.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She had a clock in her room that she loved to watch tick-tock. One day, Lily's mommy gave her a present. It was a box with something interesting inside. Lily opened the box and found a shiny necklace. She put it on and showed it to her mommy.

Later that day, Lily went outside to play in the garden. She found a spot where the dirt was soft and easy to dig. She decided to bury her necklace in the ground so that she could find it again later. She dug a hole with her hands and carefully placed the necklace inside. Then she covered it with dirt and patted it down.

Days went by and Lily forgot where she buried her necklace. She looked and looked but couldn't find it. One day, while she was playing in the garden, she saw something shiny peeking out of the ground. She dug and dug until she found her necklace. She was so happy and showed it to her mommy again. From that day on, Lily never forgot where she buried her special things.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to draw pictures of her favorite animals, like bunnies and puppies. One day, Lily's mom said, "Lily, let's organize your drawings so we can find them easily."
Lily asked, "What does organize mean?"
"It means we can put all your bunny drawings together and all your puppy drawings together," her mom explained.
Lily thought that was a great idea. She went to her room and brought out all her drawings. Her mom helped her sort them by animal, and then they put them in a big folder to keep them safe.
After they finished organizing, Lily's mom said, "Let's print a picture of your favorite animal and put it on your wall."
Lily thought for a moment and said, "I love bunnies. They are so sweet!"
So they printed a picture of a cute bunny and hung it on Lily's wall. Lily was so happy to see her organized drawings and her sweet bunny picture every day.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to climb trees in the park. One day, she climbed a tall tree and shouted, "Look how high I am!"
Suddenly, she heard silence. She looked down and saw that her mom was gone. She was scared and started to cry. "Mommy, where are you?" she shouted.
But then she heard a strong voice from below. It was her daddy! "I'm here, Lily. Don't worry, I'll help you down." And he did. From that day on, Lily always climbed trees with her daddy by her side.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. She loved to play outside in the fields near her house. One day, she found a big bag of corn lying on the ground. She picked it up and took it home.
Her mommy cooked the corn for dinner that night. It was very mild and tasty. Lily smiled as she ate it all up. After dinner, she went to bed feeling very happy.

The next day, Lily woke up and went outside to play again. She saw a scarecrow in the field and decided to go say hello. As she got closer, she saw that the scarecrow was wearing the same shirt as her daddy! She smiled and ran back to the house to tell her mommy.

Later that day, her daddy came home and they all went outside to see the scarecrow. Lily's daddy was surprised to see his shirt on the scarecrow. He smiled and laughed, realizing that he must have left it in the field when he was helping with the corn harvest. From then on, they always checked the scarecrow for any lost items before leaving the field.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. Lily loved to travel with her family. One day, they went on a trip to a faraway place. Lily was very excited to see new things.

At night, Lily's mom lit a candle in their room. Lily watched the candle flicker and dance. She wanted to play with the candle, but her mom said no. Lily felt anxious because she really wanted to touch the candle.

The next morning, Lily woke up to a bad smell. The candle had fallen over and started a fire. Everyone had to leave the hotel and go home early. Lily learned that it's important to listen to her mom and not play with dangerous things like candles.

chapters.title: Once upon a time a little…
p: Once upon a time, a little girl named Lily was playing in the park. She was having so much fun on the swings and the slide. Suddenly, she saw a man with a big box.
"Hello little girl, would you like to create something with me?" the man asked.
"Yes please!" Lily replied excitedly.

The man opened the box and took out some paper and paint. Together they started to create a beautiful fair angel. Lily was so happy with their creation and said, "Thank you for helping me make this pretty angel. I will keep it forever!"
The man smiled and said, "It was my pleasure. Remember, you can create anything you want with your imagination."

Lily thanked the man and ran home with her new fair angel. She couldn't wait to show her mom and dad what she had made. From that day on, Lily loved to create things and use her imagination to make the world a more beautiful place.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a bunny named Betsy. Betsy loved to draw with pastels, but her room was always messy. Her mom told her to tidy up before she could draw.

Betsy started to clean up her room, but she was sad because she wanted to draw. Suddenly, her friend Sammy arrived. Sammy also loved to draw, but he had a big box of pastels that he shared with Betsy.

Betsy was happy to see Sammy, but she was also worried because her room was still messy. Sammy noticed and said, "Don't worry about your room, let's draw together!" Betsy was so excited and they drew beautiful pictures together. Betsy realized that sometimes it's okay to have a messy room as long as you have good friends to draw with.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a little girl named Lily. One day, her mommy gave her an envelope to give to their neighbor. Lily was excited to help her mommy. She walked to their neighbor's house and knocked on the door.
The neighbor opened the door and said, "Hello, Lily! How can I help you?"
Lily handed her the envelope and said, "My mommy said to give this to you."
The neighbor smiled and said, "Thank you, Lily. You are such a helpful girl. Is there anything you need help with?"
Lily thought for a moment and said, "I'm uncomfortable because my shoes are too tight."
The neighbor said, "I care about you, Lily. Let's go inside and find you some more comfortable shoes."

Lily was so happy that her neighbor cared about her. They went inside and found some soft and cozy slippers for Lily to wear. From that day on, Lily knew that she could always count on her neighbor to care for her.
